name: Fred Banan
bio: Fred Banan opened a barber shop in Medora in May 1885, in George Fitzgerald's old dwelling, which E. G. Paddock had moved across the river and set up next to his barn. In June 1885 he left for Fort Keogh to finish his army enlistment while Frank Axthelm ran the shop, returning in August, and in November 1885 he married Miss Georgiana Jordan. In March 1886 he was taken into custody at Medora on an assault and battery charge after a dispute with a newsboy on the train, his fine and costs coming to a little over $31, and by June 1886 Harry Reynolds was running the barber shop in his place.
